name: oot_enemy_flare_dancer
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Flare Dancer miniboss in Majora's Mask: a whirling dancer of flame that hurls fire. Explosives, the hookshot or a Goron pound knock out its core; catch the core three times to win. Custom enemy oot.flare_dancer and its soul soul.oot.flare_dancer. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
